Initialize a Walled-Off Honest-Broker Key & Crosswalk Custody Enclave

Source: R/broker-enclave.R
broker_enclave_init.Rd

Creates a "dicom_broker_enclave" whose cryptographic master keys, HashiCorp Vault / KMS credentials, and patient-identity crosswalks live inside an isolated internal closure inaccessible to pi, coordinator, annotator, auditor, admin, and site_admin principals.

Usage

broker_enclave_init(
  work_dir = tempfile("broker_enclave_"),
  backend = c("local_vault", "hashicorp_vault", "kms"),
  passphrase = NULL,
  vault_url = NULL,
  vault_token = NULL,
  logger = NULL
)

Arguments

work_dir

Walled broker workspace directory.

backend

Key custody backend: "local_vault", "hashicorp_vault", or "kms".

passphrase

Optional passphrase for "local_vault" key derivation.

vault_url

Optional HashiCorp Vault / KMS endpoint URL.

vault_token

Optional Vault token (never exposed by print/str).

logger

Optional "dicom_audit_logger" from audit_logger().

Value

An opaque S3 "dicom_broker_enclave" handle.
